UGC-SAP-DRS-II DEPARTMENT OF LINGUISTICS
BHARATHIAR UNIVERSITY
Call for Research Papers and Articles to be Published in International Peer-Reviewed Journal
“WORKING PAPERS ON LINGUISTICS AND LITERATURE”
Published by the Department of Linguistics, Bharathiar University, Coimbatore
(Research paper submission period – From 12.10.2026, 10.00 A.M to 11.11.2026, 05.00 P.M)
1. Information for Authors
 The articles published in the Journal are in a wide range of topics in Linguistics & Literature.
 It is ensured that the research articles processed for publication will be kept in a confidential and
that no content of the research articles will be disclosed to anyone other than the corresponding
author.
 All the research articles go under a double blind review.
 The plagiarism and AI-generated content in the research article must not exceed 20%. Articles
exceeding this limit will not be accepted.
 Article in Tamil and English languages are accepted. ( Tamil Article Arial Unicode font Must)
 Use the template provided in the Department website. : TEMPLATE PAGE LINK
 Soft copy of the articles should be sent in both Doc and Pdf format to:
linguisticsjournal@buc.edu.in
 Strictly adhere to the instructions given, else article will be rejected.
2. Submission Guidelines
 The author should make sure that the research article is original and should not be published in
any other journals.
 Necessary and appropriate citations are to be mentioned in the articles under the reference head.
 The author should indicate explicitly all primary and secondary sources that have supported the
research.
 The authors should ensure that all co-authors are acknowledged and all the co-authors have
affirmed the final version of the paper.
 A brief biographical note of each author, not exceeding 50 words, must be included along with
the manuscript
 A signed declaration from the author(s) stating the originality of the manuscript and confirming
that it has not been published or submitted elsewhere.
 For further details refer the Department website: INSTRUCTION PAGE LINK
Editorial Team
